paragraphs: (Dathan and Aviram, sons of Eliav; beginning of Numbers 16.) R' Yehoshua ben Aviram; Esther Rabbah 4:4.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Miqra Numbers 16:1 verse explicitly gives Dathan and Aviram as sons of Eliav. The whole Midrash Rabbah TE Esther Rabbah 4:4 paragraph is a bounded nonmatch for Yehoshua ben Aviram; his uncollated abbreviated title therefore remains R'. Hyman’s two separate pointers and locators remain, without importing another Esther locator, asserting a common father, or supplying a canonical genealogy.
